name: Manual Tool Changer
author: ncSender
description: Manual tool change workflow with Tool Length Setter (TLS) support.

LOAD_MESSAGE_MANUAL.title: Loading
LOAD_MESSAGE_MANUAL.heading: Load this tool into the spindle
LOAD_MESSAGE_MANUAL.message: Please install {toolNumber} securely, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.

UNLOAD_MESSAGE_MANUAL.title: Unloading
UNLOAD_MESSAGE_MANUAL.heading: Remove this tool from the spindle
UNLOAD_MESSAGE_MANUAL.message: Please remove {toolNumber}, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.

SWAP_MESSAGE_MANUAL.title: Tool Change
SWAP_MESSAGE_MANUAL.heading: Swap to this tool
SWAP_MESSAGE_MANUAL.message: Please remove the current bit and install {toolNumber} securely, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
SWAP_MESSAGE_MANUAL.continueTask: Remove the current bit and install {toolNumber} securely, then continue.

SWAP_FROM_PROBE_MANUAL.title: Tool Change
SWAP_FROM_PROBE_MANUAL.heading: Swap the probe for this tool
SWAP_FROM_PROBE_MANUAL.message: Please remove the probe and install {toolNumber} securely, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
SWAP_FROM_PROBE_MANUAL.continueTask: Remove the probe and install {toolNumber} securely, then continue.

LOAD_AFTER_PROBE_MESSAGE.title: Tool Change
LOAD_AFTER_PROBE_MESSAGE.heading: The machine picks this tool up from the pocket
LOAD_AFTER_PROBE_MESSAGE.message: Remove the probe and confirm {toolNumber} is placed securely in the pocket. Keep hands clear. Click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
LOAD_AFTER_PROBE_MESSAGE.continueTask: Remove the probe and check that {toolNumber} sits securely in the pocket. Keep hands clear, then continue.

LOAD_MESSAGE.title: Loading
LOAD_MESSAGE.heading: The machine picks this tool up from the pocket
LOAD_MESSAGE.message: Confirm {toolNumber} is placed securely in the pocket and keep hands clear. Click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
LOAD_MESSAGE.continueTask: Check that {toolNumber} sits securely in the pocket. Keep hands clear, then continue.

LOAD_AFTER_MANUAL_MESSAGE.title: Tool Change
LOAD_AFTER_MANUAL_MESSAGE.heading: The machine picks this tool up from the pocket
LOAD_AFTER_MANUAL_MESSAGE.message: Remove the current bit and confirm {toolNumber} is placed securely in the pocket. Keep hands clear. Click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
LOAD_AFTER_MANUAL_MESSAGE.continueTask: Remove the current bit and check that {toolNumber} sits securely in the pocket. Keep hands clear, then continue.

UNLOAD_MESSAGE.title: Unloading
UNLOAD_MESSAGE.heading: The machine puts this tool into the pocket
UNLOAD_MESSAGE.message: Ensure the pocket is empty and keep hands clear. Click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
UNLOAD_MESSAGE.continueTask: Make sure the pocket is empty. Keep hands clear, then continue.

MANUAL_LOAD_PROBE.title: Load Probe
MANUAL_LOAD_PROBE.heading: Load the probe into the spindle
MANUAL_LOAD_PROBE.message: Please install the probe tool securely, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
MANUAL_LOAD_PROBE.continueTask: Install the probe securely, then continue.

MANUAL_UNLOAD_PROBE.title: Unload Probe
MANUAL_UNLOAD_PROBE.heading: Remove the probe from the spindle
MANUAL_UNLOAD_PROBE.message: Please remove the probe tool, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.
